description: This file implements client classes for socket communication over TCP, IPv6, and Vsock protocols, including connection handling, error logging, and descriptive methods.

classes.name: TcpClient
classes.description: A client class for establishing TCP socket connections, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

classes.name: VsockClient
classes.description: A client class for establishing Vsock connections.

methods.name: TcpClient::Start
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the specified host and port over TCP, handling IPv4 and IPv6, and logs connection status.

methods.name: TcpClient::Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the TCP connection parameters.

methods.name: VsockClient::Start
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a Vsock server with specified ID and port, and logs connection status.

methods.name: VsockClient::Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the Vsock connection parameters.
